IBM Plex Sans (IBM Corp.), SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL.txt).
WOFF2 latin and latin-ext subsets, normal and 400 italic, from Google Fonts
on 2026-11-01, font version 3.201 as the files' name tables state it. Body
face of the build-sheet theme.

The normal files are one variable font with a weight axis from 100 to 700;
build-sheet.css uses it for the weights 400 to 600. Google Fonts served the
same file under three names, for 400, 500 and 600. The copies for 500 and
600, byte for byte the file for 400, were removed on 2026-11-28.
